tasks.title: Define Drizzle Schema
tasks.description: Create the Drizzle schema files for starred_repo, github_stars, starred_repo_map, starred_repo_tag, and starred_repo_tag_map.

tasks.title: Configure D1 Migrations
tasks.description: Generate D1 migrations into the ./drizzle directory and add the 'migrate:db' script to package.json.

tasks.title: Implement D1 Insert-Select Utility
tasks.description: Create a database utility wrapper to handle D1's auto-increment limitation, ensuring it performs an INSERT followed by a SELECT to safely return IDs.

tasks.title: Scaffold OpenAPI Boilerplate
tasks.description: Set up the Hono router with @hono/zod-openapi. Implement mandatory endpoints: /openapi.json, /swagger, /scalar, /health, /context, and /docs.

tasks.title: GitHub Webhook Ingestion Route
tasks.description: Create a secure, Zod-validated webhook endpoint to ingest star and unstar events from GitHub.

tasks.title: Implement SCD Mapping Logic
tasks.description: Write the logic for handling Star List renames/merges, utilizing the fk_replacing_star strategy defined in the implementation plan.

tasks.title: AI Gateway Integration
tasks.description: Set up the Cloudflare Agents SDK to route through AI Gateway using the GEMINI_API_KEY for all LLM calls.

tasks.title: Repository Analysis Queue
tasks.description: Build the background job/queue to fetch new repo data, prompt the AI for tags, descriptions, and the mindmap config.

tasks.title: Vectorize Ingestion
tasks.description: Fetch the README.md for new repos, generate embeddings, push to Cloudflare Vectorize, and update the rag_uuid in D1.

tasks.title: Scaffold Astro + React Islands
tasks.description: Initialize the Astro frontend with React integration. Configure Tailwind and set up the Shadcn CLI to force the Default Dark Theme.

tasks.title: Build Main Landing Page
tasks.description: Fetch grouped D1 data. Implement Shadcn Accordion for star lists, Badges for tags, and the 'New Repos' highlighted alert section.

tasks.title: Implement Reactive Sheet Sidebar
tasks.description: Implement the Shadcn Sheet component. Ensure clicking different repository rows dynamically updates the Sheet's AI analysis and mindmap state without closing it.

tasks.title: Build Audit Workspace
tasks.description: Create the interactive chat UI for auditing and merging star lists using the AI Assistant.
